career_ladder.note: SSC CHSL provides entry into clerical and data operations cadres across central government ministries, subordinate offices, and constitutional bodies. Staff enter as Lower Division Clerks (LDC), Junior Secretariat Assistants (JSA), or Data Entry Operators (DEO) and progress through the Central Secretariat Clerical Service (CSCS) or departmental administrative cadres.

exam_scheme.note: SSC CHSL operates in two computer-based tiers. Tier I is a qualifying screening examination of 100 questions (200 marks, 60 minutes) with 0.50 negative marking. Tier II is the merit-determining stage: Section I (Maths & Reasoning, 180 marks) and Section II (English & General Awareness, 180 marks) generate the 360-mark merit ranking, while Computer Knowledge and Skill/Typing tests are qualifying modules.

financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated at Level 2 entry basic pay (₹19,900) for LDC/JSA with 58% DA. Data Entry Operators (DEO) are placed at Pay Level 4 (₹25,500 basic, gross ₹44,000 - ₹54,000) or Level 5 (₹29,200 basic).
official_perks: Government accommodation / House Rent Allowance (27%/18%/9% by city category)
Transport Allowance (₹1,350 + 58% DA in Class X/Y, ₹900 + DA in Class Z)
Medical facilities under CGHS or CS(MA) rules
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and defined contribution pension under NPS
Paid annual leave, casual leave, and medical leave entitlements

competition_benchmarks.note: SSC CHSL receives immense participation from 10+2 diploma and graduate holders across India, with 20-30 lakh candidates applying each year. The 2024 cycle notified approximately 3,712 vacancies across central departments, compared to 1,211 in 2023 and 4,522 in 2022.
